SQUADRON

Draw your battle. Lead your squadron.

Everything you need to know to fly, fight and win.
Version 2.0

1
Getting started

Welcome, pilot!

1
Pick your language & name

On the very first launch, tap a flag, then type your pilot name. You can change it any time in Settings, or with the flag button on the main menu. 8 languages are included.

2
Tap PLAY

Choose a mode: Classic (dice, turn by turn), Arcade (real-time waves) or Time Attack (beat the clock).

3
Challenge a friend

1 VS 1 on one phone, face to face, or on two phones over Wi-Fi / Bluetooth.

4
Collect stars & awards

Every Classic level gives up to 3 stars. 18 awards to unlock (also on Google Play Games).

2
Modes

Choose your battle

Classic

The original table game. Roll the die, draw your missile, outsmart the enemy. 100 levels with bosses, new enemy types and surprises.

Arcade

Real-time action. Hold your guns to draw. Endless waves, a bonus stage every 5 waves, 3 credits to keep going.

Time Attack

60, 120 or 180 seconds. Score as much as you can. Every wave you clear adds 5 seconds.

1 VS 1

Two pilots. One phone (turn-based or real-time) or two phones over Wi-Fi / Bluetooth.

3
Classic · basics

Roll & draw

1
Tap the red die

You roll 1–6.

2
Tap one of your guns

Guns sit on your wing tips (yellow rings). Your ink missile grows straight ahead by the number you rolled. Hold your finger to preview: the label says HIT!, CUT, MISS or +n.

3
Read the bubbles

The number next to each gun is how many squares are still needed to hit. A yellow bubble is within one roll (6 or less). – means nothing to hit in that lane.

4
Take turns

Then the enemy does the same. Destroy the whole enemy squadron to win.

4
Classic · tactics

Hits, cuts & lanes

RuleWhat it means for you
HITA missile that reaches an enemy ship damages it. Fighters fall with 1 hit, armored ships need 2, tanks 3 (the small dots under a ship show its health).
CUT!If your missile runs through an enemy missile in the same column, it erases it and keeps going. The best defence against a shot that is about to hit you.
Nose lanesA lane aimed at the centre (nose) of an enemy ship can't be cut, because there's no enemy gun there. Find these lanes!
Empty lanesA missile with nothing in front of it flies off the page (MISS). If no lane has a target, MOVE a ship.
MOVESlide a ship 1 square sideways. Uses your turn and erases that ship's lines, but can open a new lane (or dodge one).
5
Classic · tray

Power-ups

Your tray at the bottom of the screen holds four tools. The small number is how many you have left. You get a fresh kit every level.

ToolEffectCosts your turn?How to use
🚀 RocketYour missile jumps +6 squares at onceYesTap the rocket, then a gun
🛡 ShieldBlocks the next hit on one shipNo (free)Tap the shield, then one of your ships, then roll as usual
⚡ LightningRoll two dice this turn and use bothNo: you still rollTap the bolt, then the die
↔ MoveSlide a ship one square left or rightYesTap move, a ship, then an arrow

The enemy gets power-ups too as the levels go up; its counts are shown under the top bar.

Classic · enemies

Know your enemy

ShipFrom levelWhat it does
Fighter12 guns, 1 hit
Armored4Thick plates: 2 hits
Interceptor6Yellow stripe. Hops sideways now and then
Bomber11Wide, 4 guns, 2 hits
Tank16One nose cannon, 3 hits
Sniper22Long nose, each shot reaches 1 square further

7
Classic · surprises

Dangers & help

💣 Bomber raid

A small bomber crosses the page from level 10. The yellow number is the turns left before it escapes. Have a missile line in its path to shoot it down, or it drops a bomb on your nearest ship.

🧱 Bunkers

From level 21 some levels have blocks in the middle. A missile that hits a block breaks it and stops. It takes a few shots to clear a lane.

✈ Reinforcements

On later levels a fresh enemy fighter flies in after some rounds. The top bar counts down.

⚡ Overdrive

If nobody gets hit for a long time, every roll gets +1, then +2… The battle always ends.

📦 Supply drop

Stuck on a level? After a couple of defeats you start the level with extra shields and rockets, and the enemy plays a little worse. Win once and it's back to normal.

9
Arcade

Real-time waves

1
Hold a gun to draw

No dice here: keep your finger on a gun and the line grows. Use several fingers on several guns.

2
Watch the ink ring

Each gun has its own ink. The ring around it empties while you draw and refills by itself.

3
Hold a tail to move

Keep a finger on a plane's tail for a moment: it lifts and a lever appears. Slide left or right, then let go.

4
Warp & bonus

Every 3 waves you warp to a new sector (bunkers included), then READY? 3-2-1. Every 5 waves a bonus stage: every 6 balloons popped = +1 credit (max 3), and your squadron is repaired.

10
Arcade & Time Attack

Credits & CONTINUE?

Like a classic coin-op: every run starts with 3 credits (the coins in the top bar).

When your whole squadron is shot down, the CONTINUE? screen counts down from 10. Tap CONTINUE to spend a credit: your squadron comes back fully repaired and the fight goes on. Your score is kept.

No credits left, or the countdown reaches 0? Game over, and your score goes on the board.

Time Attack

Choose 60, 120, 180 seconds or CUSTOM (1–60 minutes). Longer runs get an ATOMIC FLASH every 3 minutes: everything freezes and the clock stops, then READY? and on you go. Clearing a wave adds +5 s. Stars depend on waves cleared: ★ 3+, ★★ 6+, ★★★ 10+. Best scores per duration are saved, and go to Google Play leaderboards.

12
Multiplayer

Two phones: Wi-Fi / Bluetooth

1
Both open 1 VS 1

Set Play on → Wi-Fi / Bluetooth and tap CONNECT.

2
One taps HOST, the other JOIN

Allow the Bluetooth / Nearby devices / Location permissions when asked. Android needs them to find nearby phones. No internet is used.

3
Connected!

The host picks the settings (ships, field, power-ups, shot clock) and taps START BATTLE.

4
Play

Each phone shows its own squadron at the bottom. After the battle the host can start a REMATCH.

Turn-based only. Keep the phones within a few metres of each other.

15
From the flight school

Tips & tricks

  • Look for nose lanes: shots there can't be cut.
  • When an enemy bubble on your ship turns small, cut it or put up a shield. Shields don't cost your turn!
  • Save the rocket for the finishing blow: +6 squares with no dice luck.
  • Lightning + a nearly finished missile often means two kills in one turn.
  • A bomber raid is coming? Leave a long line in its path.
  • Boss: take out the engines early, and it can't dodge anymore.
  • Bunkers: break through where it opens a nose lane.
  • Arcade: don't empty every gun at once. Keep ink for cutting. Hold a tail (not a gun) to dodge.
  • Drag a ship out of a lane that is about to be hit.
  • 1 VS 1 real-time: both players can cut, so watch the other side's ink rings!

The Back button pauses a battle. Leaving the app pauses it automatically.
